tools.name: verifiable-handoff-receipt
tools.description: For a multi-agent handoff, PASS and FAIL are not enough, and CONNECTED or APPLIED is not VERIFIED, so a later reader cannot tell a side effect from a recomputed check. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Stores a recomputable handoff receipt with explicit APPLIED, VERIFIED, or UNVERIFIABLE state,
